interpretation: Desktop string release timings showed 4–5% regressions with under 0.005% extra instructions. One bounded laptop comparison of the exact executables is flat (both pass). Retain both observations; no claim of improvement on strings or universal absence of layout sensitivity.
Object/keyword/numeric improvements are relative to the previous Dewy library, not a C JSON parity claim.
Two string-copy prototypes regressed escaped inputs and were dropped; raw measurements retained.
Fixed ea1cba0e and accepted cd07ea34 are unchanged. The 250k/C-like goals are not yet reached.
reproduction: python3 -m tools.sloppy_core.benchmark_json --baseline OLD/bin/dewy-core --core NEW/bin/dewy-core --json report.json; full-size 7 paired samples, CPU 1. Maintained benchmark_instructions supplies six matched compilation workloads.
